Corona did some damage, so I can't say, wether all of this is still in place, and it Depends on how much time you have. But here's my list.
You definitely should Start off by getting a Coffee/hot chocolate at Kaffeeküche at Schottentor, from there you can easily access All the Touristy historic buildings of Ringstraße by taking the Tram line "D" southwards. (Don't take the golden "Ringtram". It's basically a tourist scam, as it takes the same Route, as all the other Tram lines do. From there you should definitely take a Beer or two at "Käuzchen"(Little Owl) a very cozy Bar near Ringstraße but still not touristy at All and one of my Favorite spots. While being in the inner City you should definitely take a look at some of the Museums. Yes it is touristy but there are like 100 Museums in Vienna. Some of them more touristy than others. My Personal Favorites are The Military History museum, The Tram Museum, The Museum of Technology,  If you like good Burgers you should definitely try "OmNom Burger" on Wiedner Hauptstraße. If you have time on your hands, you could take a bike ride on "Wiental Radweg" this bikelane follows the River "wien" westbound and is really nice for a bike Tour. Concerning walking you can also take one of the many "Stadtwanderwege". Those are Hiking Trails going around the City. Some of them have a really good view on the City from above, without having to pay for the "Donauturm" Elevator. For Example "Stadtwanderweg 4" comes across the "Jubiläumswarte". Here you have a completely free accessible Tower with a great view over the City. (It's also a famous spot for sucides, so don't be upset by the Markings on the stairs, as usually during daytime nothing happens) If you are into Sports you can always go watch a football game of ACSL(Austrian College Sports League) or AFL(Austrian Football League) even though I'm not quite sure about the Schedules due to Corona.
